      A practice
      in layers.

      Painting, collage & installation

      Hriday Sakaria is a Houston-based artist working across painting, collage, and installation.

      Using impasto, torn paper, and raw materials, he explores texture, contrast, and the marks left by each layer.

      Follow the workInstagram @hridaysakariaart
